$comment: Generated by orchestrator/backend/scripts/generate_agent_schemas.py from app.api.assessment.AttackChainRecordRequest plus agent-side overlays where the CLI contract is intentionally stricter than the backend model.

chain_key.title: Chain Key
chain_key.description: Stable kebab-case identifier for this chain (e.g. 'anon-rce-via-sqli-lfi'). Omit to auto-generate.

title.title: Title
title.description: One-line chain summary: initial access + pivots + terminal impact (e.g. 'Anon SQLi → LFI → RCE on app server').

status.title: Status
status.description: Chain lifecycle state (e.g. 'active', 'exploited', 'reported'). Mirrors finding workflow_status vocabulary.

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: Combined chain severity — set to the highest severity of constituent findings unless the chain itself escalates impact.

narrative.title: Narrative
narrative.description: Step-by-step attack story: initial foothold, each pivot, and terminal impact. Reference linked finding slugs inline.

evidence_ref.title: Evidence Ref
evidence_ref.description: Path or ID of the artifact documenting the chain (e.g. 'scans/chain-rce-proof.txt'). Leave empty if evidence is in linked findings.

relation.title: Relation
relation.description: How this entity participates in the chain (e.g. 'step', 'prerequisite', 'outcome', 'credential-used').

entity_id.title: Entity Id
entity_id.description: Database ID of the linked entity. Provide entity_id OR entity_ref, not both.

entity_ref.title: Entity Ref
entity_ref.description: Slug or string reference when entity_id is unavailable (e.g. 'sqli-search-q').

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: How this step connects to the next or why this entity is part of the chain.

title: Assessment Attack Chain
